propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls that silently recover only the first 50 issues instead of all project issues
search_issues defaults to max_results=50 without pagination, causing truncation of results beyond the first page without raising an error
get_parent_map was previously affected by the same truncation bug and was fixed in change 1105, but two sibling methods were left with identical defects

a shared _paged_search pager must be extracted and used by all three methods to ensure they advance by returned row count and terminate only on empty pages, preventing fourth instances of this defect class
get_parent_map must be migrated to use the shared pager despite already being correct to prevent the shared pager and the method that motivated it from drifting
